scope: Read-only source audit, not biological outcome analysis or final frame alignment

method.headers: abfload(file, info); TIFF imfinfo where frame_count is recorded
method.images: Only first frame read by imread or Tiff.read; different first-frame content establishes files differ, not whole-movie identity with NWB
method.pulse_edges: Channels 1 and 5, one-based; decoded data > 1 native channel unit; rising edge t=(sample_index-1)*sample_interval_us/1e6; falling edge at first low sample
method.train_grouping: New train when consecutive rising-edge gap > 1 second; measured last pulse end is not nominal protocol end
method.channel_identity_evidence: KX stimulation CSV specifies camera channel 1 and puffs channel 5; historical behavior code uses data(:,5)>1 despite a conflicting channel-4 comment. Preserve original unit labels; channel 1 A label is not treated as physiological current.
method.clock_limit: ABF seconds are relative to acquisition start; no assumed equality to NWB image t=0; actual camera edges retained
method.eligibility: No approved analysis windows; first 1200 camera edges form a candidate sequence requiring final TIFF-to-camera correspondence and QC
